name: Arnie Rolento
source:
Arnie Rolento is an adventurer that applied for the job presented by Happiness Pharmaceutical to exterminate the monsters in the dungeon below their Factory.

[spoiler]Arnie Rolento was the leader of the Bear Group Division of the Angel Army, the extremist Organization that fought for the rights of Monsters. Her division represented the offensive unit of the Organization, being the primal combat force specialized in taking down their enemies with frontal battles. She worships her boss and Leader of the Angel Army, Archibald, and follows all his orders with unquestionable devotion and loyalty. [/spoiler]

[From [url=https://alicesoft.fandom.com/wiki/Arnie_Rolento]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
